explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 89 to 59 lines (33.7%) and from 6,358 to 4,238 characters (33.3%). Four peripherals expand publication dependencies, incremental record projection, delivery/recovery, and session lifetime changes. Component boundaries express modular structure; branches mix ownership, calls and data dependencies where useful. Positions use measured tree dimensions with gaps, and edges reference meaningful 1-based lines.

Source-grounded refinements: the seed's statement about camera samples is limited to session publication. MappingPage.tsx:1190 forwards camera changes to SourcePaneViewState, and workspacePersistence.ts:79-85 captures view/camera records independently. Unpausing is not itself a replay: setPaused only sets a flag (workspacePersistence.ts:26); the page explicitly updates and syncs afterward (MappingPage.tsx:895-898). Identical encoded-body reuse lasts within a worker instance; worker failure clears the worker handle, so a subsequent request can recreate it and re-encode the retained batch (workspaceStorage.ts:14-33; workspaceStorage.worker.ts:34-38). HTTP rejection classification follows response.json(), so an unreadable 4xx body does not reach the REJECTED branch (workspaceStorage.worker.ts:41-47).

Details absent from the seed include exact dirty-state dependencies and publication order (canvasSession.ts:69-102), history cursors advancing before acknowledgement and the index's lack of hidden-ID filtering (workspacePersistence.ts:31-34,48-68), copy semantics (canvasWorkspace.ts:42-59), and projection preserving existing sessions while transfer installation seeds replacements (MappingPage.tsx:662-675,733-759).

Evidence is limited to context.json and seed.json. Renderer behavior is described by the supplied CanvasSession comments and page wiring; renderer, controller, view-state and server implementations are not supplied. Their internal timing, normalization guarantees and server-side atomicity/idempotency are therefore not independently established.

diagrams.ascii:
Browser Workspace Ownership
|-- Browser composition: MappingWorkspacePage
|   |-- Creates CanvasWorkspace; selects injected or locally owned WorkspaceStorage
|   |-- Loads project catalog and stored workspace concurrently
|   |   `-- Restores drafts or opens a requested/available canvas; attaches persistence
|   |-- First activation mounts an editor; visited inactive canvases stay mounted
|   |   `-- Visibility does not end sessions; epoch/reload keys can remount editors
|   `-- Commands resolve controllers by document ID, including headless sessions
|-- CanvasWorkspace: owns draft registry and session lifetimes
|   |-- drafts[id] holds metadata and a stable CanvasSession handle
|   |-- Document/canvas/history seed -> create session and register controller
|   |-- Same session handle -> retain editing context and update saved baseline
|   |   `-- Tracked metadata changes notify persistence
|   |-- Removed/replaced session -> unsubscribe, unregister controller, dispose
|   `-- Document changes refresh registry entries; status supplies dirty-scene IDs
|-- CanvasSession: owns controller, cursor-copy state and saved baseline
|   |-- Public read/subscribe stores hide their mutable backing stores
|   |   |-- document: document reference
|   |   |-- presentation: display and diagramViews
|   |   |-- selection and controls: separate subscriptions
|   |   |-- geometry: endpointBounds, cell and version
|   |   `-- status: isDirty, sceneDirty, canUndo and canRedo
|   |-- Controller notification -> synchronously publish changed stores
|   |   `-- Changed canvasRevisionId -> onCommit -> workspace.onPersist([id])
|   |-- Mounted editor owns live geometry and undo navigation
|   |   `-- Camera changes also use the separate SourcePaneViewState path
|   `-- Save acknowledgement updates captured baseline; newer edits may stay dirty
|-- WorkspacePersistence: translates live owners into incremental records
|   |-- workspace.onPersist(ids) -> sync affected drafts and workspace index
|   |-- Session cursor -> persistenceChanges(cursor) -> history record delta
|   |   `-- First sync/replacement removes obsolete revision/checkpoint records
|   |-- Metadata, baseline and captured canvas views join each draft's changes
|   |   `-- Capture viewport on first sync or changed draft viewport reference
|   |-- View-state subscription -> capture display/camera into view records
|   |-- Removed draft -> delete document-prefixed records
|   |-- Active ID/transfers -> index with project ID and document IDs
|   |-- Deduplicate keys; skip stored content-addressed items -> RecordStorage.batch
|   `-- Page resumes persistence with explicit unpause, update and sync calls
|-- Shared delivery: RecordStorage -> WorkspaceStorage -> reusable worker
|   |-- batch(): update cache synchronously; skip equal values and absent deletions
|   |   `-- Keep latest pending change per key; default 150 ms debounce, 1 s window
|   |-- pump(): one flight with requestId, expectedRevision and frozen changes
|   |   `-- New edits accumulate separately while the flight awaits acknowledgement
|   |-- Worker normalizes records and caches encoded request body by requestId
|   |   `-- POST workspace records endpoint; success advances revision/sequence
|   |-- Uncertain failure retains flight; retry same request, capped backoff
|   |   `-- Recognized rejection/conflict stops background scheduling
|   |-- flush(): await acknowledgement of sequence captured at entry
|   |-- commit(): flush prior writes, retain old cache, submit and await transaction
|   |   `-- Retry uncertainty; definitive rejection restores cache and abandons flight
|   `-- load/save/saveDocument/restore share the storage facade
|       `-- Transfer/projection UI installs prepared state after acknowledgement
`-- Lifetime boundaries
    |-- Hidden browser tab -> flush view state and attempt storage flush
    |-- Pending view/storage changes or dirty/busy drafts -> beforeunload warning
    |-- Page cleanup detaches persistence and disposes sessions and view state
    |   |-- Locally owned storage: attempt flush, then dispose and terminate worker
    |   `-- Injected storage retains its external owner's lifetime
    `-- Abrupt tab termination has no flush guarantee

Session publication and dirty-state dependencies
|-- CanvasSession exposes readable facades
|   |-- getState, getInitialState, subscribe; no backing-store setState
|   `-- Controller and cursorCopy remain public command/state handles
|-- One controller notification: compare next snapshot with previous
|   |-- Changed scene/edges references -> recompute their stateKey values
|   |-- Publish presentation, selection, controls, geometry, then status
|   |-- Publish document last among stores, only when its reference changes
|   `-- Save previous snapshot; changed canvasRevisionId -> commit listeners
|-- Status derives from current content and saved baseline
|   |-- sceneDirty = sceneKey differs from savedSceneKey
|   |-- isDirty = sceneDirty OR edge-key difference OR name != savedName
|   |-- canUndo/canRedo come from controller snapshot
|   `-- Publish status only when at least one status field changes
|-- updateBaseline(input)
|   |-- Parse changed savedScene/savedEdges and recompute saved keys
|   |-- Missing savedEdges defaults to an empty array
|   `-- Replace baseline and republish status without emitting onCommit
|-- CanvasWorkspace subscriptions separate consumers
|   |-- document -> replace draft entry, preserving the same session
|   |-- status -> recompute IDs whose sceneDirty is true
|   `-- onCommit -> increment changes version and notify persistence
|-- Headless geometry uses estimated layout
|   `-- Native anchors are renderer-local; legacy renderer may supply endpoints
`-- dispose() clears cursor-copy state, controller subscription and commit listeners

Incremental record projection
|-- WorkspacePersistence constructor
|   |-- Read active ID and transfers from cached workspace index
|   |-- Subscribe to workspace.onPersist and view.subscribe
|   `-- Sync union of stored document IDs and current drafts
|-- Private bookkeeping
|   |-- WeakMap<CanvasSession, sequence> tracks history submission cursors
|   `-- Map<document ID, CanvasDraft> tracks prior draft/viewport references
|-- sync(ids): inspect each current draft
|   |-- Missing draft -> delete all cached keys with its document prefix
|   |-- Present draft -> metadata (including controller version) and baseline
|   |-- persistenceChanges(cursor) -> historyChanges(id, delta)
|   |   |-- No cursor: delete obsolete revision/checkpoint keys in same batch
|   |   |-- No cursor: skip already stored immutable revisions
|   |   `-- No cursor: skip checkpoint only if prior is delta and JSON is equal
|   |-- Advance cursor to delta.sequence before network acknowledgement
|   |-- captureDisplay + canvas snapshot -> canvasViewChanges
|   `-- First/changed viewport reference -> captureCamera -> optional viewport
|-- syncView(id): independent of history cursor
|   `-- Existing draft -> capture display and camera; submit view/viewport records
|-- Index selects active ID if present, otherwise first draft ID
|   `-- Also stores projectId, all draft IDs and transfers; no hidden-ID filter
|-- submit(): last change per key wins; stored /item/ values are skipped
|   `-- Deletions pass through; RecordStorage handles further value equality
`-- setPaused only changes a flag; paused sync/syncView return immediately

Write acknowledgement, retries and worker ownership
|-- RecordStorage has three distinct states
|   |-- cache: latest submitted values visible synchronously
|   |-- pending: latest changes by key, waiting for a new flight
|   `-- flight: fixed batch and sequence retained until successful response
|-- pump() shares running Promise; successful write clears flight/error/failures
|   `-- revision and persisted sequence advance only on acknowledgement
|-- Background schedule
|   |-- Normal delay = min(configured delay, remaining 1 s pending window)
|   |-- Failure delay = min(30000 ms, 500 ms * 2^min(failures, 6))
|   `-- Stop for disposed storage, REJECTED, VERSION_CONFLICT, REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|-- Explicit commit differs from background scheduling
|   |-- First flush earlier writes; capture cache; batch transaction changes
|   |-- REJECTED -> restore cache, clear pending/flight, mark sequence settled, throw
|   `-- Other failures -> wait 500 ms and retry while not disposed
|-- WorkspaceStorage owns lazy worker and numeric request-ID Promise map
|   |-- Reuse worker; response resolves/rejects matching request and removes entry
|   |-- Worker error -> reject outstanding requests, terminate and clear handle
|   `-- Later request can construct a new worker
|-- Worker owns encoded bodies by batch requestId and known serialized records
|   |-- Write -> normalize once per cached body; POST identical body on retry
|   |-- Success -> update known records; drop body
|   |-- Parsed HTTP 4xx -> drop body and report REJECTED
|   `-- Transport/server/JSON-read failure -> body remains for retry in this worker
`-- Worker replacement loses body/known caches
    |-- Retained main-thread flight can be resent and re-encoded
    `-- project(snapshot) reads full state first if new worker is uninitialized

Creating, replacing and releasing canvas state
|-- copyDocument: new session without requiring a mounted editor
|   |-- Reject missing/hidden/busy source, invalid name or expectedVersion mismatch
|   |-- Clone canvas; clear selection and reset controls
|   |-- Retain conversation messages but set thread.pending = false
|   |-- Fork history; clone viewport; reuse source document input
|   `-- New draft UUID, savedName = empty, source scene/edge baseline
|-- Projection: preserve existing session lifetimes
|   |-- Prepare from source history and cell; recheck source version
|   |-- saveDocument(child, index, create=true) checks cached metadata collision
|   `-- After acknowledgement, add only child session; retain existing editors
|-- Transfer: replace workspace session inputs
|   |-- Prepare histories, documents, views and transaction
|   |-- storage.save(snapshot): flush -> worker full-record diff -> commit
|   `-- After acknowledgement, installWorkspace seeds all drafts
|       `-- New sessions, new view state and incremented editor epoch
|-- Page publication save: captured content defines saved baseline
|   |-- Sync draft and flush; reject if controller version changed
|   |-- Publish checkpoint with captured revision/version and fresh requestId
|   `-- Acknowledgement applies captured scene/edges/name; retain newer name edits
|-- WorkspaceStorage.restore()
|   `-- Flush, dispose current RecordStorage, clear load Promise, reload via worker
`-- Teardown responsibilities
    |-- Session removal/replacement unregisters controller before disposing session
    |-- Page schedules workspace/local-storage cleanup with a zero-delay timer
    |   `-- Effect replay cancels that timer; injected storage is not disposed
    `-- Storage disposal terminates worker and rejects outstanding requests
